Ping — round-trip time & packet loss

What it measures

Ping measures the round-trip time (RTT) for a small message sent from your machine to a destination and echoed straight back — it's the fastest way to check if a host is reachable and how much latency exists on the path. The ttl=118 shown is the Time-To-Live value remaining when the reply arrived, and 0.0% packet loss confirms every packet round-tripped successfully.
